ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley No. 23 de 27 de abril de 2015 (as amended) constitutes the primary AML/CFT statute and establishes the Unidad de Análisis Financiero (UAF); Decreto Ejecutivo No. 363 de 2017 provides the UAF implementing regulation; Ley No. 52 de 27 de octubre de 2016 amended Ley No. 32 de 1927 to abolish bearer shares, mandate immobilization, and require every resident agent to maintain a confidential Register of Ultimate Beneficial Owners (Registro de Beneficiarios Finales); Ley No. 70 de 2017 strengthened money-laundering penalties and forfeiture; FATF/GAFILAT membership obligations apply, together with UAF Resolutions on customer due diligence and suspicious transaction reporting.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all shareholders, directors, signatories, and UBOs against the United Nations Security Council Consolidated List (1267/1988 and successor regimes), OFAC SDN and non-SDN lists, EU and UK consolidated financial sanctions lists, GAFILAT advisories, and domestic UAF alerts. PEP determination must apply the FATF three-category framework (domestic, foreign, and international), including family members and close associates, with negative-media and adverse-information checks via commercial intelligence databases. Enhanced due diligence is required for any PEP, high-risk jurisdiction, or sanctions flag. Suspicious transactions must be reported to the UAF within five business days. Customer due diligence records must be re-verified at least annually for this low-risk digital-health-app profile, with a documented risk tier of Low_Risk_Standard.
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_ownership_threshold_note: Direct or indirect ownership or control through any means at a threshold of 25% or higher triggers mandatory identification and filing of the ultimate beneficial owner with the resident agent; senior managing officers must be identified even where no qualifying UBO is found.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Público de Panamá — Servicios en Línea / Registro Digital (rp.gob.pa), complemented by the national single-window platform 'Panamá Tramita' of the Government of Panama.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Names may be registered in Spanish or any foreign language expressed in the Latin alphabet. Non-Latin script names must be transliterated and, where required, accompanied by a Spanish translation filed with the name-search application. The corporate name must contain a corporate identifier such as 'Sociedad Anónima', 'S.A.', 'Corp.', 'Inc.', or 'C.A.'. The registry rejects names identical, phonetically identical, or deceptively similar to an existing registered entity, and names contrary to public order, decency, or mandatory law. A certified 'Certificado de Búsqueda y Depósito de Nombre' must be obtained before drafting the public deed of incorporation.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Minería / Mining (where concession or regulated activity is implied)
Petróleo / Oil / Gas (where concession or regulated activity is implied)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Within the thirty-day reservation window the applicant may request one or more extensions before inscription. Upon a formal rejection certificate, the applicant must file a 'recurso de reconsideración' before the competent Director or Registrador within five working days pursuant to Ley No. 38 de 2000. If denied, the applicant may file a hierarchical 'recurso de apelación' before the hierarchical superior within five working days of notification. Concurrently, the applicant may submit a new name-search application with a modified or disambiguated variant. Judicial review is available through a 'demanda contencioso-administrativa' before the Sala Tercera de lo Contencioso-Administrativo de la Corte Suprema de Justicia.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible for this digital-health-app company. The statutory registered office is the physical office of the licensed Panamanian resident agent under Ley No. 32 de 1927 as amended by Ley No. 52 de 2016. No local employees, physical premises, or domestic servers are statutorily required because distribution occurs through Apple IAP and Google Play Billing from the app provider's host infrastructure. A virtual office is acceptable provided it is not a bare mail-drop without representation, and the economic substance position is accurately disclosed in the annual substance filing under Ley No. 254 de 2021 and in the residency analysis applied by the Dirección General de Ingresos (AIP).
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low (estimated 5% annual probability) for a low-risk digital-health-app company with no PEP shareholders and no local payroll. Probability increases to approximately 15–20% if the company claims Panamanian central management and control, applies for an ITBM (VAT) refund or tax certification, or is flagged for nominal-address-only substance. Unannounced on-site visits are primarily conducted by the AIP and licensed-agent oversight authorities rather than by UAF enforcement for this classification.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley General de Sociedades (General Corporation Law) No. 32 of 27 February 1927, as amended by Law 5 of 2011 and related provisions; Sections governing incorporation, directors, officers, and registered agents.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Dirección de Personas Jurídicas / Registro de Personas Jurídicas (Public Registry of Panama, Legal Persons Registration Directorate)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Pacto Social y Estatutos (Articles of Incorporation and Bylaws), formalized in an Escritura Pública and inscribed in the Public Registry
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital and no escrow account deposit is required. The Articles commonly authorize a capital stock of US$10,000 divided into 100 shares, which may be subscribed as determined by the incorporators.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the incorporator's subscription of the Company's initial issued shares is hereby approved and the corresponding share certificates shall be issued to the founding shareholder. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the registered office of the Company shall be established at ______, Ciudad de Panamá, República de Panamá. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the following officers are appointed: President, Secretary and Treasurer, each with full statutory powers and signatures. RESOLVED FURTHER, that [Name of law firm] is appointed Resident Agent of the Company. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the President and Secretary are authorized to execute the filing with the Registro Público, open bank accounts, adopt digital payment rails, and attend to all corporate formalities.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Online Name Consultation Module through a licensed Panamanian notary or registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit up to three proposed corporate names to the Public Registry's name consultation mechanism. Verify that the selected name for the Sociedad Anónima is not confusingly similar to an existing registered entity. Obtain the name approval/non-conflict certificate from the notary or registry.
required_dossiers: Proposed corporate name(s) and alternatives
Identification documents of the incorporator/subscriber
Intended authorized capital statement
Name consultation application form
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected for similarity, submit a revised name or an alternative variation through the same module. No formal appeal procedure is required; re-filing is administrative and immediate.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarization of Pacto Social y Estatutos
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Pacto Social y Estatutos in compliance with Law 32 of 1927, including corporate purpose, share capital structure, board powers, registered office, and appointment of officers and resident agent. Execute the document before a Panamanian notary and pay applicable notarial protocol and stamp fees.
required_dossiers: Draft Articles of Incorporation and Bylaws
Name approval certificate issued by the Public Registry
Passport or ID of each shareholder and officer
Consent letter of the proposed Resident Agent
Registered office address proof or declaration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If notarial execution is challenged or documents contain omissions, the notary will correct the deed and resubmit it for signature. Any legalization or apostille defect must be cured before registration.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Public Registry Inscription of the Corporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Dirección de Personas Jurídicas
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Present the notarized Escritura Pública and supporting documents to the Legal Persons Registration Directorate. Pay the registry inscription fee. Obtain the certified inscription and certificate of corporation registration, which evidences legal existence.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of the notarial public deed
Notary final certification
Name approval certificate
Government fee payment receipt
Power of attorney of the filing agent if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Public Registry issues a notice of defect or omission, cure the exact objection, execute corrective addenda if necessary, and resubmit the dossier to the same registry section for re-examination without restarting the full incorporation process.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Taxpayer Registration and Municipal Operation Filing
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) and Municipio de Panamá (Alcaldía de Panamá)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the incorporated S.A. with the DGI to obtain the Registro Único de Contribuyentes and tax ID. Concurrently file the Aviso de Operación/Empresa with the Municipality of Panama, pay the municipal patent fee, and obtain the operating notice required for commercial or digital business activity.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of the registered corporation deed
RUC registration form
Municipal Aviso de Operación application
Officer identification documents
Lease agreement or proof of registered office address
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the DGI or municipality rejects the filing due to incomplete information or conflicting address data, correct the registered corporate data at the Public Registry or resubmit the revised forms to the respective authority with the required corrective attachments.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First Board Meeting and Organizational Governance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Corporate board, officers, and Resident Agent; corporate records maintained at registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting or adopt a unanimous written consent resolution. Approve the First Board Resolution covering share subscription, registered office adoption, officer appointments, resident agent retention, banking authorities, and use of digital payment rails. Record all resolutions in the corporate minute book and share ledger.
required_dossiers: Draft first board minutes or written consent
Officer acceptance letters
Share subscription evidence and share certificates
Resident Agent appointment confirmation
Corporate ledger and minute book
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a quorum or voting defect is alleged, cure by obtaining a unanimous written consent signed by all directors, which is valid under Panama corporate law and cures the procedural irregularity.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Bank Account Setup and Payment Rails Activation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Panamanian bank and corporate officers; may require Resident Agent certification
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open the corporate bank account in Panama using the registered resolution and public registry evidence. Request bank onboarding approvals for Apple IAP and Google Play Billing as payment channels for the digital fitness app; execute merchant agreements in the corporate name.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of Public Registry inscription
First board resolution and officer ID
RUC registration certificate
Aviso de Operación for business address
Bank account opening forms and beneficial ownership declaration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank requests enhanced due diligence responses, provide a corporate structure chart, source of funds declaration, and digital app business summary. If bank onboarding is delayed, apply through another licensed bank or use a licensed payment processor in Panama.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Municipio de Panamá (Alcaldía de Panamá) for Aviso de Operación; Ministry of Commerce and Industries (MICI) is not a licensing body for pure software programming activity under ISIC 6201
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Aviso de Operación / Patente Municipal (Municipal Business Operation License and Tax Receipt)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministerio de Ambiente (MiAMBIENTE) – Environmental Assessment Directorate
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category III / Exempt – No full Environmental Impact Assessment required for office-based digital software development and fitness application telemetry services; administrative environmental classification is filed only if physical premises exceed municipality thresholds.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable to digital software operations. If a physical office is leased, comply with Panama City municipal wastewater, solid waste, and noise ordinances; no industrial VOC discharge or hazardous emission limits are triggered.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Inspection Certificate from Cuerpo de Bomberos de Panamá for the registered office space; occupational workplace safety compliance with MITRADEL if employees are hired; no health-sector operational license required for a software-only fitness tracker platform.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI), Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas (MEF); official taxpayer portal: Sede Electrónica DGI (https://www.dgi.mef.gob.pa)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a Panama Sociedad Anónima (S.A.), the statutory RUC (Registro Único de Contribuyentes) is obtained by filing the grantor's public incorporation deed (Escritura Pública) and the DGI registration application with the corporate name certification, bylaws, appointment of directors, and resident agent details. Foreign shareholders are permitted; the application is signed by the authorized legal representative and submitted through the DGI state electronic platform or physically at DGI service centers. Where the S.A. acts as a non-resident digital service provider with Panama-source sales, a simplified DGI registration procedure is available in lieu of establishing a permanent establishment.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Panama does not provide a check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch entity classification election. All Sociedades Anónimas are automatically treated as juridical persons subject to entity-level taxation on Panama-source income only. The optional small-taxpayer simplified regime (annual gross income ≤ USD 36,000) may be elected for income tax purposes, but does not alter entity classification; special territorial economic zone elections (e.g., SEM, City of Knowledge) may apply separately.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: ITBMS (Impuesto de Transferencia de Bienes Muebles y Servicios) - VAT
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No statutory turnover threshold for general ITBMS registration; every person undertaking taxable transfers of movable goods or services in Panama must register with the DGI. The small-taxpayer simplification threshold of USD 36,000 applies to administrative burden reduction, not to registration exemption. Non-resident digital service suppliers must register upon first taxable supply to a Panama-resident consumer, subject to de minimis administrative rules.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Panama mandates electronic invoicing (Facturación Electrónica) for all taxpayers through the DGI-authorized clearance system or accredited private electronic invoicing service providers (PSFEs). Invoices must be transmitted to the DGI in real time using the official XML schema, carry a digitally generated verification hash and qualified electronic stamp, and include the ITBMS breakdown and RIS (Registro de Información del Sujeto) codes. The DGI validates the invoice, assigns a unique control number, and performs digital fiscal clearance prior to taxpayer issuance.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Goods exported from Panama qualify for the 0% ITBMS rate provided the transfer is supported by a valid customs export declaration and the goods physically leave Panamanian territory. Services, including digital health and fitness application services, qualify for zero-rating if the service is provided to a non-resident recipient, the recipient's utilization of the service occurs entirely outside Panama, and the service is not partially performed within Panama. The supplier must maintain contemporaneous documentation showing the non-resident status of the customer, the offshore place of use or enjoyment, and the foreign currency consideration received.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Bill of Lading (BL) or Airway Bill (AWB)
Inward Remittance Certificate (Certificado de Respaldo de Divisas)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The DGI may require proof of export zero-rating during standard or targeted audits. Failure to produce the customs declaration, transport document, and FX inward remittance certificate within the statutory deadline (generally 180 days from shipment or service invoicing) triggers reversal of the zero rate, immediate assessment of unreported ITBMS at 7%, late interest, and surcharges. Fraudulent export zero-rating claims (including falsified bills of lading, over-invoicing, or fake non-resident certifications) are treated as tax evasion subject to administrative fines equal to 100% of the omitted tax, criminal penalties under the Panama Criminal Tax Offenses Act (Ley de Evasión Fiscal), including imprisonment up to 5 years, and a statutory clawback limitation period of 11 years.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá (SBP) — Panama has no central bank; the SBP is the banking and monetary-system regulator under Panamanian banking law, while the United States dollar serves as the legal tender.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Full convertibility on both current and capital accounts. The Panamanian balboa (PAB) is a nominal accounting unit pegged at exactly one balboa per U.S. dollar and exists only as coinage. There are no restrictions on the purchase, sale, transfer, or remittance of foreign exchange. Non-resident shareholders may freely inject capital and remit profits, dividends, and proceeds without central bank approval. No prior licensing or exchange-control permit is required for foreign direct investment in a Panamanian S.A. engaged in software publishing and digital health application services. The only relevant hurdle is compliance with commercial bank AML/KYC documentation requests and, where applicable, tax payment or withholding obligations under the territorial tax system.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Not applicable. Panama does not maintain an exchange-control regime, and there are no statutory surrender or conversion requirements for export receipts. Exporters, including providers of digital services, may retain foreign-currency earnings in Panamanian bank accounts, move them offshore, and use them for payments without mandatory conversion ratios or return timelines. This applies to USD and all other freely convertible currencies.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low direct viability. Panama has no separately regulated electronic money institution (EMI) licence comparable to the EU. Under the Panamanian Banking Law, only licensed banks are authorised to take deposits or intermediate public funds. Offshore digital EMIs may not service Panamanian clients as deposit-taking institutions or operate local settlement accounts without a banking licence. They may, however, act as payment facilitation or white-label software providers to a licensed local bank under a written outsourcing or business-correspondent arrangement, subject to SBP AML/CFT approval and the local bank retaining full responsibility for the customer relationship. For the specific Health Fitness App Tracker, the practical onboarding route remains a tier-one Panamanian commercial bank with robust USD clearing, supplemented by Apple IAP and Google Play Billing settlement via their global acquiring networks.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical appearance of at least one natural-person director, the ultimate beneficial owner (UBO), and the designated authorized signatory is generally mandatory for first-time corporate account opening. Panama-based banks commonly require an in-branch interview at the bank's local offices. Fully remote account opening is not permitted as a standard route for a newly formed S.A. with non-resident shareholders. A Panamanian resident officer hold a notarised and registered power of attorney may attend in place of a foreign director, but the UBO identity and source-of-funds evidence must still be verified. Some private banks allow an initial virtual interview, followed by a physical visit or notarised documentation delivery; this is decided on a case-by-case risk-basis.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Ultimate beneficial owner resides in a FATF grey-listed or high-risk jurisdiction, or has family links to a politically exposed person (PEP).
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Documented source-of-wealth statement for the preceding three years; federal or equivalent tax returns; corporate chart showing the complete ownership chain up to each natural person; independent PEP screening report; sworn declaration of no adverse regulatory action; notarised and apostilled birth certificate or passport evidence; and corroborative professional references from an approved legal, accounting, or corporate-services firm.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unclear or non-traditional source of the initial capital injection, such as crypto-currency proceeds, offshore booking credits, or a large unsecured shareholder loan.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Bank statements from the remitting regulated financial institution for the last six months; transaction narrative and invoice or share-subscription agreement; audited financial statements of the investing entity or proof of liquidity from an annualised salary and bonus schedule; SWIFT confirmation of the inbound transfer; source-of-funds certification under Panama's Law 23 of 2015; and legal opinion from Panama counsel confirming the capital contribution is reflected in corporate minutes and the capital register.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Transaction monitoring flags triggered by expected high-volume, low-value digital app subscriptions settled via Apple IAP and Google Play Life, producing passive monthly revenue that is inconsistent with a new corporate entity's historical profile.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Detailed business plan covering projected subscriber volumes and revenue curves; executed agreements with Apple and Google containing payout terms and merchant identifiers; prior settlement statements from Apple and Google showing the originating payor; a formal written AML/CFT manual applicable to the corporate treasury function; end-user KYC/CAPT verification protocols and privacy policy; data protection registration receipts if applicable; and a user-acquisition model demonstrating the legitimate revenue stream.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Pepper-looking or unusual cross-border clearing pattern, such as use of an intermediary bank in a third country rather than direct USD clearing through a U.S. correspondent.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Rationale memorandum describing the commercial reason for the clearing corridor; contractual evidence of the third-country distributor or payment aggregator; SBP-compliant transaction screening logs; confirmed SWIFT MT103 format fields including exact purpose code and bank reference; and an undertaking signed by the director accepting the bank's right to require transaction-level documentation and to suspend activity pending clarification.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound capital injections for a Panamanian S.A. are executed through the international banking network in USD. Recommended routing: remitting bank → U.S. correspondent bank (e.g., JP Morgan Chase, Bank of America, or Citibank) → Panamanian beneficiary bank's SWIFT/BIC → the company's operational account. The wire must include the beneficiary's account name and number, the company's SAP/Inscripción, and a narrative in the SWIFT MT103 field 70 stating 'Equity Contribution to PA_CORP S.A. under corporate resolution; no prior FX authorization required.' For amounts above USD 25,000, the receiving Panamanian bank will request the corporate resolution authorising the capital increase, a share-subscription register or stock ledger, the notarised certificate of the registered capital, and identification and ultimate beneficial ownership documentation. No filing or registration with any exchange-control authority is required; the funds are freely available for operational use and settlement of trade obligations.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound trade disbursements are cleared through Panamerican and international USD rails. Domestic USD transfers use cheque clearing and the local automated clearing house managed by the Panamanian Bank Association and Banco Nacional de Panamá. Cross-border trade settlements use SWIFT MT103 for direct wire payments, documentary letters of credit issued by the purchaser's bank through SWIFT MT700 and governed by UCP600, and SWIFT MT202 for bank-to-bank reimbursement. For the digital health fitness app, recurring payout settlements from Apple and Google Play are received through international ACH and SWIFT MT103 credit transfers into the local USD operating account. High-value disbursements for licences, cloud services, and copyright royalties are best executed by SWIFT MT103 with the express purpose code 'T' (general transfer) or 'L' (licence/franchise) and supporting invoices retained for six years under Panamanian commercial record-keeping rules.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable U.S. Dollar / Panamanian Balboa forward contracts at a fixed 1:1 parity (available for accounting tidiness but economically redundant due to complete dollarisation)
Deliverable U.S. Dollar / Euro forward contracts at the principal Panamanian commercial banks
Deliverable U.S. Dollar / Pound Sterling forward contracts
Cross-currency interest rate swaps involving USD floating benchmarks against EUR or GBP fixed legs
Vanilla foreign exchange options for payment of foreign-currency invoices in cloud infrastructure and digital distribution agreements
Multilateral netting or cash-pooling arrangements through a single local treasury account to reduce cross-currency conversion costs

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Franchise Tax (Impuesto Anual de Sociedades)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI), Ministry of Economy and Finance
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before October 31 of each calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: 10% surcharge if paid in November; 20% surcharge if paid in December; monthly interest of 1.5% thereafter; failure for two consecutive years may result in administrative strike-off from the Public Registry.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Shareholder Sworn Statement (Informe de Accionistas)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before April 30 of each calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines up to USD 100 plus late-filing interest; persistent non-filing may lead to the Public Registry suspending corporate registration and imposing administrative penalties on the resident agent.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Corporate Income Tax Return (Declaración de Renta) if Panama-source revenue is derived
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before March 31 for fiscal year ending December 31 (3 months after fiscal year-end)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing fine up to USD 200; interest of 1% per month on unpaid tax; understatement penalties up to 50% of omitted tax; criminal prosecution for fraudulent non-filing.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Independent external audit becomes mandatory if the corporation exceeds annual gross revenues of USD 2,500,000, or total assets of USD 4,000,000, or employs more than 50 staff; below these thresholds, an audit is generally optional for non-regulated private companies.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Panamanian GAAP (based on IFRS) for general corporate accounting; full IFRS is required for publicly listed entities and financial institutions licensed by the Superintendency of Banks.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The resident agent must obtain and retain a sworn declaration of beneficial owners and maintain an updated beneficial owner register at the registered office. Any shareholding transfer altering the UBO structure must be reported to the DGI Beneficial Ownership Registry within 15 days. An annual UBO confirmation is required to be filed by the resident agent on or before March 31 each year.
